title: Namespaces this project mints
description: Every namespace IRI folio-assistant mints for itself, with what each one names. Code reads the values from here (schemas/namespaces.ts); external-schemas:check fails on a spelling of ours that is not listed, and on a retired one still in use.

source.note: owner, 2026-09-23: code lists as nodes rather than constants in code

codes.label: bootstrap vocabulary
codes.definition: JSON-LD terms the bootstrap instance declares; the prefix is the instance stub.

source.note: schemas/namespaces.ts, where each was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: cat-harness vocabulary
codes.definition: JSON-LD terms the cat-harness instance declares; the prefix is the instance stub.

source.note: schemas/namespaces.ts, where each was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: folio-assistant-core vocabulary
codes.definition: JSON-LD terms folio-assistant-core declares; the prefix is the instance stub.

source.note: schemas/namespaces.ts, where each was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: DSpace qualified fields
codes.definition: Where a DSpace qualified Dublin Core field name with no DCMI equivalent is minted, under the content layer that owns the Dublin Core model.

source.note: folio-assistant-core/schemas/dublin-core.ts DSPACE_NS, a constant until 2026-09-23; found unlisted by the bean 2j09 JSON-LD scan

codes.label: legacy single vocabulary
codes.definition: The single namespace every term used before the per-layer split. Kept so the vocabulary document can name the stem it published under; never minted into.

source.note: schemas/namespaces.ts, where each was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: content @base
codes.definition: The @base every emitted content document resolves relative ids against. An IRI this project mints, but a base rather than a vocabulary: no term hangs off it.

source.note: schemas/jsonld.ts FOLIO_BASE, where it was a constant until 2026-09-23

codes.label: BPMN extension elements
codes.definition: The XML namespace folio:skill, folio:bean, folio:adjudication and the other BPMN extension elements are in.

codes.label: bootstrap's BPMN extension elements
codes.definition: The XML namespace of the BPMN extension elements bootstrap declares for its own diagrams: skill, role and precondition. Its prefix names the declaring Subgraph, bootstrap.processes.

source.note: bean 12s9 stage 2, owner 2026-09-24: prefix = declaring Subgraph (dotted path), address option 1 (…/ns#)

codes.label: cat-harness's BPMN extension elements
codes.definition: The XML namespace of the BPMN extension elements cat-harness declares for diagrams: bean, policy, adjudication, no-skill, no-call, job, implements, judgement, fulfilment, raci, involvement, link, decision, log and convention. Its prefix names the declaring Subgraph, cat-harness.processes.

source.note: bean 12s9 stage 3, owner 2026-09-24: prefix = declaring Subgraph, address <stub>/<subgraph>/ns#

codes.label: never-ours BPMN spelling
codes.definition: A spelling of the extension namespace on a domain this project does not own. Listed only so a check can name it when it reappears.

codes.label: process diagrams
codes.definition: The targetNamespace every process diagram declares, so every calledElement names a process in the caller's own namespace.
